name: 4-colour handheld game level
doc: Turns the input media into a scrolling 4-colour dot-matrix handheld platformer level where picture luma and edges auto-tile into brick platforms, spinning beat coins, and an animated pixel runner that leaps on beats.

luma.doc: media brightness mask (core-media.luma) rendered as the 4-shade dithered world and solid terrain

edges.doc: media edge gradient (core-media.edges) generating steppable ledges and floating collectible coins

palette.doc: 4-colour handheld LCD ramp (shade 0 darkest ink to shade 3 lightest backlight)

speed.doc: horizontal level scroll speed synced to tempo

grid.doc: authentic dot-matrix LCD pixel gap and shadow strength

dither.doc: 4x4 Bayer ordered dithering into the 4 handheld shades

jump.doc: runner beat-jump height and onset bounce

coins.doc: density of spinning collectible beat coins along media edges
